decision: Use project scene-extension workflow; object-factory generator is not applicable
reason: The img2threejs suitability rubric rejects scene references as isolated-object inputs. This task is an extension of an existing architectural scene, not standalone mesh reconstruction. Preserve the attempted intake and its strict-validation failures rather than claim passing object gates. Use approved source, explicit layout/animation contract, direct runtime model tests and actual multiview rendering.
referenceMaterialLimit: Generated scene pixels are not PBR texture measurements. Extend existing independently authored game materials.
